dataset: Seoul administrative dong and district boundaries, 2026-10-01 snapshot
upstream: Statistics Korea SGIS administrative boundary data, edited by author to reflect administrative changes
license: CC BY 4.0 for processed data; upstream SGIS attribution under KOGL Type 1
attribution: 본 데이터는 통계청 통계지리정보서비스(SGIS, https://sgis.kostat.go.kr)에서 공공누리 제1유형으로 개방한 행정동 경계를 가공한 것이며(가공: vuski/admdongkor, https://github.com/vuski/admdongkor), CC BY 4.0으로 배포됩니다.

derived_dong_fields.area_m2: Geometry area in EPSG:5179 square metres

derived_district_fields.dong_count: Number of source administrative dong per district

processing: Subset the independently downloaded nationwide source to Seoul; preserve all source dong properties and geometries; derive areas; dissolve by district code/name; no course or prior assignment files used.
limitations: Community-maintained derivative; not the definitive legally authoritative boundary. Author notes some boundaries may differ from actual boundaries.
Snapshot label is 2026-10-01; upstream SGIS base vintage and different constituent geometry edit dates are not a single synchronized 2026 survey.
427 Seoul dong reflects the 2025-07-01 split of Yongshin-dong into Yongdu-dong and Sinseol-dong. Older 426-dong tables require matching or aggregation.
Polygon areas are computed from this source in EPSG:5179, not official statistical land areas.

Source polygons have minor geometric overlaps totalling approximately 707.09 square metres (0.000117% of Seoul union area). Original geometries are preserved; any point-to-dong join should select one district/dong deterministically for multiply matched points rather than double count them.
